Is there anything else a beginner needs to get started?
A few basics will help:
Check your bed base: A firm, flat platform or foundation works; slats should be no more than 3 inches apart. You don’t need a box spring, and we recommend keeping the mattress off the floor.
Consider a mattress protector: It’s optional for the warranty, but helps guard against spills and moisture.
Choose your feel: For Serenade, the options are Firm, Cushion-Firm, and Plush.
That’s a good starting checklist—no special accessories are required.

turns.replyText:
How do I use it properly the very first time?
For your Serenade mattress:
Unbox it as soon as you can, then lift and gently shake each corner to help it expand.
You can sleep on it once it’s fully expanded—airing it out is optional. A slight natural-material odor may fade over a few days.
Use a firm, flat base; if it has slats, keep them no more than 3 inches apart. Avoid placing the mattress directly on the floor.
Rotate it head-to-toe every 3–4 months if you’d like to encourage even wear. It’s one-sided, so don’t flip it.
